name: HC27b: Total Tested
description: Number of pregnant or breastfeeding women active on ART whose 3-month post-ART-initiation milestone falls within the reporting period and who had evidence of a viral load test during that period. The patient must meet all HC27a eligibility criteria and must additionally have a VL episode during the reporting period. The VL date is determined using sample_collection_date, falling back to viral_load_clinical_date, laboratory_result_date, and finally order_date; however, an order alone is not sufficient to establish testing unless there is evidence of specimen collection, a clinical VL date, a laboratory result, or a valid result.

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT r.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen r
WHERE r.art_start_date IS NOT NULL

  AND DATE_ADD(r.art_start_date, INTERVAL 3 MONTH) >= :startDate
  AND DATE_ADD(r.art_start_date, INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
      < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
      WHERE s.patient_id = r.patient_id
  )

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
      WHERE a.patient_id = r.patient_id
        AND a.encounter_date <= :endDate

        AND (
            (
                a.encounter_date >= :startDate
                AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
            )
            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )

        AND (
            FIND_IN_SET(
                'PREGNANT',
                REPLACE(a.pregnancy_status, ', ', ',')
            ) > 0
            OR FIND_IN_SET(
                'Breast feeding',
                REPLACE(a.pregnancy_status, ', ', ',')
            ) > 0
        )

        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card x
            WHERE x.patient_id = a.patient_id
              AND x.encounter_date > a.encounter_date
              AND x.encounter_date <= :endDate
        )
  )

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode v
      WHERE v.patient_id = r.patient_id

        AND COALESCE(
            v.sample_collection_date,
            v.viral_load_clinical_date,
            v.laboratory_result_date,
            v.order_date
        ) >= :startDate

        AND COALESCE(
            v.sample_collection_date,
            v.viral_load_clinical_date,
            v.laboratory_result_date,
            v.order_date
        ) < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

        AND (
            v.sample_collection_date IS NOT NULL
            OR v.viral_load_clinical_date IS NOT NULL
            OR v.laboratory_result_date IS NOT NULL
            OR v.is_valid_result = 1
        )
  );
